name: why-diff
description: Trace every hunk of an AI agent's diff back to the prompt and tool call that wrote it. Flags unrequested changes and test tampering.

scripts.build: tsup src/cli.ts src/index.ts --format esm --clean --target node20 && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --emitDeclarationOnly --declaration
scripts.eval: npx -y promptfoo@0.120.19 eval -c evals/promptfooconfig.yaml -o evals/results.json --no-cache && node evals/score.mjs
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build

author: Mateusz Kania
